3) What to do right now to limit damage
- Turn off the water to the sink:
  - Look under the sink for two small shutoff valves (for hot and cold).  
  - Turn both clockwise until they stop.  
- If you can’t find the under‑sink valves, turn off the main water:
  - Often in a closet, garage, or at a curb box outside.  
- Empty the cabinet:
  - Remove items so they don’t get soaked/moldy.  
  - Use towels to soak up standing water and put a bowl or tray under the leak.  
- Don’t run the faucet or dishwasher until a plumber looks at it.
